Relevate is a Brisbane-based operations, strategy and technology consulting firm that helps businesses unlock the full value of their software. We work across CRM implementation, IT managed services, virtual staffing and digital transformation advisory, with particular depth in the Zoho ecosystem. Plenty of firms can install software; our real point of difference is adoption. We make sure the people using the tools genuinely embrace them, because that is where return on investment is actually realised. Our work is practical and outcome-driven. We have helped clients cut integration costs, reduce monthly licensing spend and reclaim days of manual reporting time each month simply by rethinking how their systems fit together. In short, we help teams work smarter rather than harder, so our clients become more profitable, more valuable and more resilient.

ICT Customer Support Officer | Relevate — Brisbane, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Serve as a first point of contact for clients experiencing issues with their CRM, business applications or supporting hardware, diagnosing problems and delivering timely resolutions
•	Assess client needs and recommend suitable software, hardware and system configurations to resolve operational challenges and close value gaps in their business tools
•	Customise and adapt existing applications, including Zoho Creator apps, CRM workflows and automations, so they align with each client's specific processes
•	Install, configure and deploy Zoho modules and other business software across client environments, ensuring each solution is set up correctly for the way the client works
•	Support and drive effective adoption of implemented systems by training end users and monitoring usage, so applications and equipment are used efficiently and deliver maximum value
•	Assist with implementing client networks and integrations between platforms, including connecting systems through tools such as Zoho Flow, and support the build and ongoing upkeep of client web portals and websites
•	Troubleshoot, repair or arrange replacement of peripheral equipment such as printers, modems and workstations as part of our managed services support
•	Assemble, install, maintain and repair computer hardware, software and related equipment as required, keeping client systems reliable with minimal disruption
•	Log, track and prioritise support requests, maintaining accurate records of issues and resolutions
•	Document configurations, fixes and processes to build and maintain an internal knowledge base
•	Escalate complex or unresolved matters to senior consultants and collaborate with the wider team to deliver solutions
•	Provide both remote and on-site support to clients as needed, and assist virtual staffing team members with the tools and systems they rely on

Skills, Qualifications and Experience
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field
•	At least 1 year of experience in an ICT support or similar customer-facing technical role

Personal Attributes
•	Genuinely customer-focused, with a patient and approachable manner
•	Well organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
•	Comfortable working both independently and as part of a close-knit team
•	Keen to keep learning and to stay across new technologies and platforms

Hours and Remuneration
This is a full-time position of approximately 38 hours per week. We are offering a salary of $75,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation per annum for the successful applicant.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping people and working with modern business technology, we would love to hear from you.

JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company, employing thousands of people across the country. We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced IT Coordinator to join our team at JBS Dinmore.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing people, driving performance, and creating a strong culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

About the Role
As an IT Coordinator at Dinmore Plant, you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting all plant IT systems to ensure operational efficiency. This role includes installing and configuring hardware and software, performing preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting technical issues. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication with non-technical users, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment. The IT Coordinator plays a key role in minimising downtime, supporting continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable technology performance across the site. This is a full-time role with annual salary not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities include:
Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance on all plant IT assets to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Install and configure new hardware, including desktop computers and industrial printers, to support operational needs.
Deploy and configure software across multiple platforms, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Modify, configure and customise existing software applications and system settings to meet operational requirements and improve user functionality and efficiency.
Assess software and hardware requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions to meet operational and user needs across the plant environment.
Configure, implement and maintain local computer networks and connectivity solutions to support business systems and operational equipment.
Assist with the design, maintenance and updating of internal web-based platforms, intranet resources or business websites to support operational and communication requirements.
Monitor, diagnose, and resolve daily IT issues throughout the plant, providing timely and effective support.
Troubleshoot and resolve user-related problems as they arise, minimising downtime and disruption.
Escalate complex issues to the broader IT support team while maintaining accountability for resolution and closure.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth IT operations.
Prepare reports and track data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus 1 year of full-time relevant experience. Alternatively, at least 3 years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualifications.
Previous experience working with varied IT hardware, software, and operating systems.
Ability to work autonomously as well as part of a greater team.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills – with the ability to explain technical issues to a non-technical user base.
Highly developed time management skills, including prioritising tasks and meeting conflicting deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
High standard of computer literacy.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills.
Previous experience in a food manufacturing/processing environment would be preferable.

What We Offer
Career development opportunities within a global organisation
Supportive leadership team and collaborative work environment
Access to employee benefits and wellbeing programs
Opportunity to make a genuine impact on workforce capability and employee success
Long-term career opportunities with one of Australia's leading employers
If you are passionate about developing people and want to be part of a business that values safety, teamwork and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

The ad is valid for 28 days.,

Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions

• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects

• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

Position Overview
We are looking for a Motion Picture Systems Analyst to support the design, analysis and continuous improvement of technology solutions that enable efficient film, television and digital media production. This role works closely with production, post-production and business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, optimise workflows and implement business systems that enhance collaboration, media management and production performance. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem solver with strong systems analysis experience and the ability to bridge business needs with technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Examine production, post-production and digital content workflows to identify opportunities for improving system performance, operational efficiency and information flow.
Consult with producers, production managers, editors, technical teams and business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document functional and technical requirements.
Evaluate existing production systems and recommend technology enhancements that improve scheduling, resource planning, media asset management and workflow automation.
Develop functional specifications, business requirements, workflow diagrams and process documentation to support software development and system integration activities.
Analyse business processes and operational procedures to ensure technology solutions align with production objectives, compliance requirements and organisational standards.
Coordinate the implementation of new applications, software enhancements and production workflow solutions while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Design, prepare and execute system, integration and user acceptance testing to validate functionality, performance and business requirements before deployment.
Investigate system issues, perform root cause analysis and recommend practical solutions that improve system reliability, usability and operational effectiveness.
Prepare user manuals, technical documentation and training materials, and deliver training sessions that support successful adoption of new technologies.
Collaborate with software developers, infrastructure teams, vendors and third-party providers to integrate production management, digital asset management and enterprise business systems.
Contribute to project planning by assisting with solution design, implementation schedules, resource estimation, risk identification and project documentation.
Provide technical advice and ongoing support to stakeholders, acting as the primary liaison between business users and technical teams throughout system enhancement initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of systems analysis methodologies, business process improvement and software development lifecycles.
Experience gathering business requirements and producing functional specifications, process models and technical documentation.
Knowledge of business process modelling, workflow analysis and system implementation methodologies.
Experience supporting system integration, software deployment and user acceptance testing.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to recommend practical technology solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands and meet project deadlines.
Proficiency with enterprise applications, databases and business systems within technology-driven environments.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within the film, television, broadcasting, streaming or digital media industry.
Knowledge of Media Asset Management (MAM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), production tracking or content management systems.
Experience integrating third-party production platforms, workflow automation tools or cloud-based media solutions.

result.description:
## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to user queries regarding hardware and software problems, providing clear guidance and timely resolutions via phone, email, or in person
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues across a range of systems, applications, and devices, escalating complex matters to senior technical staff where appropriate
- Assess software and hardware requirements to develop practical solutions that meet user and business needs
- Install, configure, and update software applications and operating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across user environments
- Adapt and modify existing programmes and applications to align with evolving user requirements and organisational workflows
- Repair, replace, and maintain peripheral equipment including printers, terminals, modems, and other connected devices
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of computer networks, contributing to the configuration and ongoing support of network infrastructure
- Support the design, maintenance, and updating of websites and internal digital platforms as required
- Promote and educate end users on the efficient and effective use of applications, equipment, and IT systems to maximise productivity
- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
- Contribute to the development and documentation of IT support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles
- Provide support within a call centre environment where required, handling a high volume of inbound technical queries with professionalism and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate IV or Diploma in Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT support, help desk, or technical services role
- Solid understanding of computer hardware, software applications, and operating systems (Windows and/or macOS)
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral equipment
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting
- Proficiency in using IT ticketing and asset management systems to log, track, and resolve support requests
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues methodically and efficiently
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
- Customer-focused attitude with a professional, patient, and approachable manner
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure
## Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or ITIL Foundation
- Experience supporting users in a call centre or high-volume help desk environment
- Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and remote desktop support tools
- Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and basic web maintenance tasks
- Experience working within ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certifications, and career development opportunities to advance your ICT career
- Enjoy flexibility in your working arrangements, with a consistent and structured shift schedule to support work-life balance
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly supports staff productivity and organisational success
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, recognising your skills and experience
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
